page: Microsoft Azure F32ads_v7 is a virtual machine instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor using the x86_64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz with a single thread per core. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled, offering 3780 GB of local disk capacity, and the instance is Premium Storage capable. Virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks position this instance in the top tier for single-core CPU performance and database operations. Multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth fall into the strong top 25% category. Cryptographic and vector operations are accelerated by hardware support for AVX-512 and AES instructions. In data processing tests, the server achieves top-tier results in single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression, alongside strong multi-threaded decompression capabilities.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and substantial local storage, the F32ads_v7 offers high resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for data-intensive workloads. The combination of high-speed dedicated cores and large local disk capacity makes it highly suitable for database operations, web serving, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks.
